title: Cookies for the Hungry Children
statement:
`n` children each have a hunger level `g_i`: a child is happy only with a cookie of size at least `g_i`. There are `m` cookies, cookie `j` has size `s_j`. Every child gets at most one cookie and every cookie goes to at most one child. Find the largest number of children that can be made happy.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. The second line contains the `n` hunger levels. The third line contains the `m` cookie sizes.

## Output
Print the largest possible number of happy children.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n, m <= 50000`
- `1 <= g_i, s_j <= 10^9`
